parameters.name: CertFile
parameters.description: The input stream of the portrait side image of the ID card. Specify either CertUrl or CertFile.

parameters.name: CertNationalFile
parameters.description: The image of the national emblem side of the ID card. Specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile, or leave both empty.

parameters.name: CertNationalUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the national emblem side image of the ID card. A publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL. Specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile, or leave both empty.

parameters.name: CertUrl
parameters.description: The image of the portrait side of the ID card. A publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL. Specify either CertUrl or CertFile.
